method: Visual reading of both rendered signed pages; narrative and allocation checked against PDF text.
boundaries: Retains October 25,2006 ward profile used in 2006 and 2011.
caste_rule: Starts afresh from five highest 2011 Census SC population shares; subsequent elections rotate down ranking.
women_rule: Nine wards through draw of lots;2016 starts afresh; subsequent elections exclude previously reserved wards until all covered.
sc_women_rule: Two women wards selected by public draw within the five SC wards.
prior_assignment: 2011 excluded all 2006 women-reserved wards; this history remains relevant to the 2011-to 2016 contrast.
limits: No ballot-level records or complete ordering/rejection protocol for interacting draws retained.
